capabilities.evidence: Bounded packages stage into state/modular-intake; path traversal, oversize files and digest mismatches are refused.
Built-in and dual-reviewed custom family contracts resolve without unknown-family coercion.
Each known family requires its declared descriptor; UCP receives its native validator and executable-capable files remain inert warnings.
Review Inbox binds promotion and family registration to exact SHA-256 digests.
Approved non-module pieces are written through a temporary directory into an immutable family/id/version path.
Approved module pieces are restaged into the existing Governed Installer, never directly installed.
Every promotion emits axm.component-backup-request/v1; absent external media remains visibly awaiting configuration.
Observatory inventories exact declared capabilities and typed contract, substrate and hand/component gaps.
Exact provides-set matching and explicit promoted-capability acceptance are covered by deterministic self-tests.
